_comment: DEGRADED-PATH FALLBACK ONLY. pr-rollup-check.py uses this ONLY when a live fetch of both the rulesets API and the classic branch-protection API fails for a real reason (network, permission, malformed response) on repo trevorotts1/openclaw-onboarding branch main. It is never the primary source and every run that uses it prints a loud DEGRADED banner. If branch protection ever changes, this file goes stale until someone re-runs the investigation below and updates it -- that staleness is the exact risk a live-first design exists to avoid, so treat any run that falls back to this file as suspect.
required_contexts: GHL MCP supervision + install regression guard
G1 — version file change requires a matching annotated tag (push to main)
G1b — every release on main must keep a truthful annotated tag
G2 — every v11+ annotated tag must have a CHANGELOG entry
G3 — skill content change requires skill-version.txt bump
